name: @gcu/lamina
description: Open any file — even a multi-gigabyte one — and scroll, filter, and sort it. A windowed, read-only viewer: a coarse record-offset block index (~1 MB at 500M rows) + @gcu/loom. delimited → grid, text → lines, binary → hex; reads inside zip/tar/gz/zst/xz/bz2, and windows huge compressed entries without unpacking. The finest stratum: thin slices (windows) of a file.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
